_meta.title: Population of Persepolis and the Marvdasht plain, 467 BCE (Xerxes yr 19), per zone, court state, time of day and season; household, work-group and ration templates; animals
_meta.tiers: A attested / B inferred (includes every search-extract value: capped at B) / C reconstructed. Every population value is a C derivation from B inputs; see 'derivation'.
_meta.access: FT = read in full this session; SX = web-search extract of a named page (capped at B); NS = not seen (model recollection, capped at C, verify)
_meta.ranges: value ranges are [min, max]; 'w' is the working value the simulation should use unless a setting overrides it
_meta.default_court_state: court_absent (DECISIONS D-003; OPEN_QUESTIONS Q-005). court_resident is the out-of-world setting 'Court calendar = seasonal pattern' (resident months 1-4), tier C.

components_court_absent.role: non-state residents: gardeners and farmers of the garden city, elite estate households, craftsmen

zones.derivation: night = sum of components (4,650-10,300, rounded to 5,000-10,000). Cross-check: 600 ha (SELOPERSE, SX, B: 'probably not densely built-up'; separate blocks among gardens, parks, fields, orchards) with 8-15 % built blocks at 65-150 persons/ha gives 3,100-13,500; 65/ha = Sumner's plain-wide mean 43,600/675 ha (my arithmetic on B inputs). Day = night - Terrace day workers (~450) + plain villagers visiting stores and the road station (200-800) - harvest labour sent to fields in summer (5-15 %). Court resident: + 8,000-20,000 retinue lodged or camped (C). Scale checks: PF 0701, 126,100 qa flour 'consumed before the king' (IR-ADMIN, SX, B) = ~4,200 man-months at 30 qa over an unstated period; the king's table 'fed 15,000 a day' is a Greek claim (ATH4).

zones.label: the rest of the Marvdasht (Persepolis) plain: villages, fields, orchards, canals, road stations

field_fraction_adults_by_day.note: barley harvest from mid-May; wheat harvest and threshing in summer; ploughing, sowing and vintage in autumn

herders_passing.note: modern Qashqai move north in April and south in September (SX; C analogue); no Achaemenid source. PF: ~700 shepherds drove 'the sheep of the king' to Susa (IR-ADMIN, SX, B)

zones.derivation: Sumner <= 44,000 sedentary in the plain (39 sites, ~675 ha; SX, B) minus the town (5,000-10,000) = 34,000-39,000 if Sumner counts the town, up to 44,000 if not (Q-038); working 36,000. Spring and autumn add transient herders. Day = night: people move into the fields within the zone. Court resident: + 3,000-10,000 in supply trains, royal herds and camps (C).

totals_court_absent.note: night, spring, working values: Terrace 125 + town 7,000 + plain 37,000 = 44,125; by day the Terrace adds ~450 who sleep in the town. About Sumner's ceiling for the plain, plus transients
